g.text: J++ part, pointer and identity outside J++ stop most 9B and 27B lookups, not Muse's
Sanity swap: lookups still switching (%) of the whole change's switches; purple line: the part's extra loss.
Under each row: the part's share of the change and n. Open marks, °: after the data, gate lowered to 0.75.
Wrong pair: mean differences of other item pairs, at the share of identity outside J++, every scene. In the
routes test, identity outside J++ cuts identity answers only 0.06 / 0.12 / 0.04 more than the wrong pair (9B
/ 27B / Muse; the bar fixed in advance: 0.15).
